definition.falsification: Empirical observation showing that scalarized reward maximization consistently identifies true Pareto-optimal policies without preference distortion.
definition.statement: Linear reward scalarization systematically fails to preserve the true Pareto-optimal preference ordering of multi-objective goal hierarchies under optimization pressure, specifically when objective weights are static.
definition.uncertainty: The extent to which weight scheduling mitigates scalarization distortion across different environment dynamics.
